blocks.text: Local Area Network (LAN) chhote ilaqe ke andar devices ko jorta hai (jaise Figure 1.3 mein). Yeh ilaqa ghar, school ya office ho sakta hai. LAN mein data transfer speed (data jane ki raftar) bohat zyada hoti hai. Aam taur par LAN ek hi organization (idare) ki milkiyat hota hai aur wahi use chalata hai. LAN mein aam taur par Ethernet (taar wala connection) aur Wi-Fi istemal hote hain. LAN cost-effective (sasta) hai aur us ki maintenance (dekh-bhaal) aasan hai.

blocks.alt: LAN ke nishan wala khula ghar: deewar par teen antenna wala router cable se mez par rakhe desktop aur laptop, deewar par tablet aur farsh par doosre router se jura hai; farsh wala router printer se cable aur tablet se Wi-Fi se jura hai. Almari par TV rakha hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Aap ke school ki computer lab, jahan saare computers ek switch se jure hain aur ek printer share karte hain, LAN ki misaal hai.

blocks.prompt: LAN kya hai? Is ki do khoobiyan batayein.
blocks.explanation: LAN chhote ilaqe (ghar, school, office) mein devices jorta hai. Khoobiyan: tez data transfer, sasta aur sambhalna aasan; aam taur par ek hi idare ka hota hai.

items: LAN: chhota ilaqa (ghar, school, office), tez, sasta, ek idare ka; Ethernet aur Wi-Fi.
